raw_prompt: Build a desktop examination lockdown sandbox that restricts dual-monitor mirroring and intercepts OS clipboard paste during active exam sessions.

examination lockdown sandbox.rationale: Desktop security sandbox application and isolated process environment.

lockdown.rationale: Process isolation and system privilege restriction action.

restricts.rationale: Enforcement action prohibiting multi-monitor display mirroring.

dual-monitor mirroring.rationale: Hardware display configuration constraint prohibited during proctored exams.

intercepts.rationale: OS-level event hooking and inspection mechanism.

OS clipboard paste.rationale: System clipboard transfer operation to be intercepted and sanitized/blocked.

during active exam sessions.rationale: Temporal state boundary defining when sandbox restrictions are actively enforced.

REQ-EXP-01.title: Disable and Block Dual-Monitor Display Mirroring

REQ-EXP-02.title: Intercept and Block OS Clipboard Paste Events

REQ-DER-01.title: Suppress OS Global Keyboard Shortcuts (Alt+Tab, PrintScreen, WinKey)

REQ-DER-02.title: Unauthorized Background Process Enumeration and Blacklisting

REQ-DER-03.title: Security Audit Logging of Sandbox Escape Attempts

REQ-SUP-01.title: Graceful Restoration of System Settings and Clipboard on Exam Exit
